blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS— Stephen Curry scored a season-high 44 points, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 and Golden State Warriors held on Wednesday night for a 119-114 victory in the NBA over the Minnesota Timberwolves, who were without injured guard Anthony Edwards. The Warriors have won two straight after opening 0-3, while Minnesota has dropped two in a row after starting 3-0. READ: NBA: Steph Curry, Warriors try to contend again in talented West Wednesday was the first test for Minnesota to see how its lineup would look without Edwards.
